Cut.label: 剪切
Cut.description: 移除所选内容并放入剪贴板

Copy.label: 复制
Copy.description: 将所选内容复制到剪贴板

Paste.label: 粘贴
Paste.description: 在当前位置插入剪贴板内容

dependencyStyles.DefaultScrollViewStyle:
<ns0:Style xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:ns1="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" xmlns:ns2="using:Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.Primitives" ns1:Key="DefaultScrollViewStyle" TargetType="controls:ScrollView">
        <ns0:Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="IsTabStop" Value="False" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="UseSystemFocusVisuals" Value="{StaticResource UseSystemFocusVisuals}" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="ContentOrientation" Value="Vertical" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="HorizontalScrollChainMode" Value="Auto" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="HorizontalScrollMode" Value="Auto" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="HorizontalScrollRailMode" Value="Enabled" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="VerticalScrollChainMode" Value="Auto" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="VerticalScrollMode" Value="Auto" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="VerticalScrollRailMode" Value="Enabled" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="ZoomChainMode" Value="Auto" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="ZoomMode" Value="Disabled" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="IgnoredInputKinds" Value="None" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="MinZoomFactor" Value="0.1" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="MaxZoomFactor" Value="10.0" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="HorizontalAnchorRatio" Value="0.0" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="VerticalAnchorRatio" Value="0.0" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="{ThemeResource ControlCornerRadius}" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="Template">
            <ns0:Setter.Value>
                <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="controls:ScrollView">
                    <ns0:Grid ns1:Name="PART_Root" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" CornerRadius="{TemplateBinding CornerRadius}">

                        <ns0:VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <ns0:VisualStateGroup ns1:Name="ScrollingIndicatorStates">

                                <ns0:VisualStateGroup.Transitions>
                                    <ns0:VisualTransition From="MouseIndicator" To="NoIndicator">

                                        <ns0:Storyboard>
                                            <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_HorizontalScrollBar" Storyboard.TargetProperty="IndicatorMode">
                                                <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsSeparatorContractDelay}">
                                                    <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame.Value>
                                                        <ns0:ScrollingIndicatorMode>None</ns0:ScrollingIndicatorMode>
                                                    </ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame.Value>
                                                </ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame>
                                            </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                            <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_VerticalScrollBar" Storyboard.TargetProperty="IndicatorMode">
                                                <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsSeparatorContractDelay}">
                                                    <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame.Value>
                                                        <ns0:ScrollingIndicatorMode>None</ns0:ScrollingIndicatorMode>
                                                    </ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame.Value>
                                                </ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame>
                                            </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        </ns0:Storyboard>
                                    </ns0:VisualTransition>
                                    <ns0:VisualTransition From="TouchIndicator" To="NoIndicator">

                                        <ns0:Storyboard>
                                            <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_HorizontalScrollBar" Storyboard.TargetProperty="IndicatorMode">
                                                <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsNoTouchDuration}">
                                                    <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame.Value>
                                                        <ns0:ScrollingIndicatorMode>None</ns0:ScrollingIndicatorMode>
                                                    </ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame.Value>
                                                </ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame>
                                            </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                            <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_VerticalScrollBar" Storyboard.TargetProperty="IndicatorMode">
                                                <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsNoTouchDuration}">
                                                    <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame.Value>
                                                        <ns0:ScrollingIndicatorMode>None</ns0:ScrollingIndicatorMode>
                                                    </ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame.Value>
                                                </ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame>
                                            </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        </ns0:Storyboard>
                                    </ns0:VisualTransition>
                                </ns0:VisualStateGroup.Transitions>
                                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="NoIndicator" />
                                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="TouchIndicator">

                                    <ns0:Storyboard>
                                        <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_VerticalScrollBar" Storyboard.TargetProperty="IndicatorMode">
                                            <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0">
                                                <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame.Value>
                                                    <ns0:ScrollingIndicatorMode>TouchIndicator</ns0:ScrollingIndicatorMode>
                                                </ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame.Value>
                                            </ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame>
                                        </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_HorizontalScrollBar" Storyboard.TargetProperty="IndicatorMode">
                                            <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0">
                                                <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame.Value>
                                                    <ns0:ScrollingIndicatorMode>TouchIndicator</ns0:ScrollingIndicatorMode>
                                                </ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame.Value>
                                            </ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame>
                                        </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    </ns0:Storyboard>
                                </ns0:VisualState>
                                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="MouseIndicator">

                                    <ns0:Storyboard>
                                        <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_HorizontalScrollBar" Storyboard.TargetProperty="IndicatorMode">
                                            <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0">
                                                <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame.Value>
                                                    <ns0:ScrollingIndicatorMode>MouseIndicator</ns0:ScrollingIndicatorMode>
                                                </ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame.Value>
                                            </ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame>
                                        </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_VerticalScrollBar" Storyboard.TargetProperty="IndicatorMode">
                                            <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0">
                                                <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame.Value>
                                                    <ns0:ScrollingIndicatorMode>MouseIndicator</ns0:ScrollingIndicatorMode>
                                                </ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame.Value>
                                            </ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame>
                                        </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    </ns0:Storyboard>
                                </ns0:VisualState>

                            </ns0:VisualStateGroup>
                            <ns0:VisualStateGroup ns1:Name="ScrollBarsSeparatorStates">

                                <ns0:VisualStateGroup.Transitions>
                                    <ns0:VisualTransition From="ScrollBarsSeparatorExpanded" To="ScrollBarsSeparatorCollapsed">

                                        <ns0:Storyboard>
                                            <ns0:DoubleAnimation Duration="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsSeparatorContractDuration}" BeginTime="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsSeparatorContractDelay}" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_ScrollBarsSeparator" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="0" />
                                        </ns0:Storyboard>
                                    </ns0:VisualTransition>
                                    <ns0:VisualTransition From="ScrollBarsSeparatorExpanded" To="ScrollBarsSeparatorCollapsedDisabled">

                                        <ns0:Storyboard>
                                            <ns0:DoubleAnimation Duration="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsSeparatorContractDuration}" BeginTime="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsSeparatorContractDelayDisabled}" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_ScrollBarsSeparator" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="0" />
                                        </ns0:Storyboard>
                                    </ns0:VisualTransition>
                                </ns0:VisualStateGroup.Transitions>
                                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="ScrollBarsSeparatorCollapsed" />
                                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="ScrollBarsSeparatorCollapsedDisabled">

                                    <ns0:Storyboard>
                                        <ns0:DoubleAnimation Duration="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsSeparatorContractDuration}" BeginTime="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsSeparatorContractDelayDisabled}" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_ScrollBarsSeparator" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="0" />
                                    </ns0:Storyboard>
                                </ns0:VisualState>
                                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="ScrollBarsSeparatorExpanded">

                                    <ns0:Storyboard>
                                        <ns0:DoubleAnimation Duration="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsSeparatorExpandDuration}" BeginTime="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsSeparatorExpandDelay}" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_ScrollBarsSeparator" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="1" />
                                    </ns0:Storyboard>
                                </ns0:VisualState>
                                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="ScrollBarsSeparatorDisplayedWithoutAnimation">

                                    <ns0:Storyboard>
                                        <ns0:DoubleAnimation Duration="0" BeginTime="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsSeparatorDisplayDelayWithoutAnimation}" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_ScrollBarsSeparator" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="1" />
                                    </ns0:Storyboard>
                                </ns0:VisualState>
                                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="ScrollBarsSeparatorExpandedWithoutAnimation">

                                    <ns0:Storyboard>
                                        <ns0:DoubleAnimation Duration="0" BeginTime="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsSeparatorExpandDelayWithoutAnimation}" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_ScrollBarsSeparator" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="1" />
                                    </ns0:Storyboard>
                                </ns0:VisualState>
                                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="ScrollBarsSeparatorCollapsedWithoutAnimation">

                                    <ns0:Storyboard>
                                        <ns0:DoubleAnimation Duration="0" BeginTime="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsSeparatorContractDelayWithoutAnimation}" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_ScrollBarsSeparator" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="0" />
                                    </ns0:Storyboard>
                                </ns0:VisualState>

                            </ns0:VisualStateGroup>

                        </ns0:VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>

                        <ns0:Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <ns0:RowDefinition Height="*" />
                            <ns0:RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
                        </ns0:Grid.RowDefinitions>

                        <ns0:Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ns0:ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                            <ns0:ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                        </ns0:Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ns2:ScrollPresenter ns1:Name="PART_ScrollPresenter" Grid.ColumnSpan="2" Grid.RowSpan="2" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" Content="{TemplateBinding Content}" Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}" ContentOrientation="{TemplateBinding ContentOrientation}" HorizontalScrollChainMode="{TemplateBinding HorizontalScrollChainMode}" HorizontalScrollMode="{TemplateBinding HorizontalScrollMode}" HorizontalScrollRailMode="{TemplateBinding HorizontalScrollRailMode}" VerticalScrollChainMode="{TemplateBinding VerticalScrollChainMode}" VerticalScrollMode="{TemplateBinding VerticalScrollMode}" VerticalScrollRailMode="{TemplateBinding VerticalScrollRailMode}" ZoomChainMode="{TemplateBinding ZoomChainMode}" ZoomMode="{TemplateBinding ZoomMode}" IgnoredInputKinds="{TemplateBinding IgnoredInputKinds}" MinZoomFactor="{TemplateBinding MinZoomFactor}" MaxZoomFactor="{TemplateBinding MaxZoomFactor}" HorizontalAnchorRatio="{TemplateBinding HorizontalAnchorRatio}" VerticalAnchorRatio="{TemplateBinding VerticalAnchorRatio}" />
                        <ns0:Grid Grid.Row="1" Visibility="{TemplateBinding ComputedHorizontalScrollBarVisibility}" Padding="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsMargin}">
                            <ns0:ScrollBar ns1:Name="PART_HorizontalScrollBar" Orientation="Horizontal" />

                        </ns0:Grid>
                        <ns0:Grid Grid.Column="1" Visibility="{TemplateBinding ComputedVerticalScrollBarVisibility}" Padding="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsMargin}">
                            <ns0:ScrollBar ns1:Name="PART_VerticalScrollBar" Orientation="Vertical" />

                        </ns0:Grid>
                        <ns0:Border ns1:Name="PART_ScrollBarsSeparator" Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="1" Opacity="0" Background="{ThemeResource ScrollViewScrollBarsSeparatorBackground}" />

                    </ns0:Grid>

                </ns0:ControlTemplate>
            </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>
    </ns0:Style>
dependencyStyles.DefaultSwipeControlStyle:
<ns0:Style xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:ns1="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" ns1:Key="DefaultSwipeControlStyle" TargetType="controls:SwipeControl">
        <ns0:Setter Property="IsTabStop" Value="False" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="MinHeight" Value="{ThemeResource ListViewItemMinHeight}" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="MinWidth" Value="{ThemeResource ListViewItemMinWidth}" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="Template">
            <ns0:Setter.Value>
                <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="controls:SwipeControl">
                    <ns0:Grid ns1:Name="RootGrid">
                        <ns0:Grid ns1:Name="SwipeContentRoot">
                            <ns0:StackPanel ns1:Name="SwipeContentStackPanel" />

                        </ns0:Grid>
                        <ns0:Grid ns1:Name="ContentRoot">
                            <ns0:ContentPresenter ns1:Name="ContentPresenter" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" CornerRadius="{TemplateBinding CornerRadius}" Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}" Content="{TemplateBinding Content}" ContentTransitions="{TemplateBinding ContentTransitions}" ContentTemplate="{TemplateBinding ContentTemplate}" HorizontalContentAlignment="Stretch" VerticalContentAlignment="Stretch" AutomationProperties.AccessibilityView="Raw" />
                            <ns0:Grid ns1:Name="InputEater" />

                        </ns0:Grid>

                    </ns0:Grid>

                </ns0:ControlTemplate>
            </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>
    </ns0:Style>
